description.en: Xianyu (Goofish 闲鱼) read-only monitoring for DeepSeek Harness: drives the goofish-cli MCP server and exposes read-only tools (search, item detail, listings, chat history, category) with all write actions filtered out.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的闲鱼只读监控：驱动 goofish-cli MCP 服务器，暴露搜索 / 商品详情 / 在售列表 / 会话历史 / 类目识别等只读工具，写操作一律过滤。
